name: Rutgar Glyphshaper
summary: At the Bronzebeard Encampment, Rutgar Glyphshaper studies the silithid hives. The dwarven archaeologist came to Silithus with Brann Bronzebeard’s expedition to uncover the hives’ mysteries in their ancient relics and runes. Brann has wandered into the desert, but Rutgar carries on.

sections.title: The Bronzebeard Expedition
sections.body: Rutgar Glyphshaper came to Silithus with Brann Bronzebeard to explore the vast silithid hives and recover relics buried beneath the desert. Their expedition made camp at the Bronzebeard Encampment, south of Cenarion Hold. Rutgar and his companions often entered the hives for inscribed stones and runic artifacts. At times, Cenarion night elf researchers worked alongside them.

sections.title: Trouble in the Hives
sections.body: In Hive'Regal, Rutgar and the night elf priestess Natalia Mar'alith found a strange glyphed crystal. Its influence left Natalia in a trance, so the dwarves carried her to Cenarion Hold for healing. Later, she returned to their camp in a wild frenzy and demanded to go back to the hive. Rutgar and the expedition fought her off, and Natalia fled into the dunes.

sections.title: Deciphering the Silithid
sections.body: Brann Bronzebeard has disappeared into the wastes, as he often does. Rutgar remains at camp, gathering crystalline rubbings and working to decipher the insectoid glyphs scattered through the hives. He hopes to piece together the silithid’s history and trace where Brann has gone.

faq.answer: Rutgar Glyphshaper is a scholar and explorer with Brann Bronzebeard’s archaeological expedition in Silithus. He is based at the Bronzebeard Encampment.
Brann Bronzebeard wandered alone into the wastes of Silithus on one of his usual scouting trips. Rutgar and the rest of the crew remain at the encampment to study the hives.

faq.q: What happened to Natalia Mar'alith at the camp?
faq.answer: After an ancient crystal in Hive'Regal influenced her, Natalia Mar'alith returned to the Bronzebeard Encampment in a violent rage. She attacked Rutgar, Brann, and the crew, then vanished into the desert.

faq.q: Why is Rutgar studying the silithid crystals?
faq.answer: Rutgar studies the silithid crystals to translate the ancient glyphs carved into them. He hopes to learn the silithid's origins and find clues to Brann's whereabouts.

faq.q: Has Ironforge sent aid to the expedition?
faq.answer: No. The expedition asked Ironforge for military support, but the dwarven kingdom declined, saying its forces were already stretched too thin defending the realm.

faq.q: Where is the Bronzebeard Encampment located?
faq.answer: The Bronzebeard Encampment lies in southern Silithus, south of Cenarion Hold and just west of Hive'Regal.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you may recognize Rutgar’s stubborn devotion to the Explorer’s League. He risks life and limb deep in hostile insect hives for ancient knowledge.
As an Alliance adventurer, you can find friendly faces at a rare outpost in the harsh southern desert. Rutgar’s crew has no official backing from the Ironforge crown.
